theater: 色雷斯與塞薩洛尼基海峽

battle.name: 克魯姆汗的戰爭
battle.theater: 色雷斯與塞薩洛尼基海峽
battle.brief: 807年，保加爾可汗克魯姆趁拜占庭與哈里發在塞薩洛尼基一線激戰，率軍越過色雷斯邊界，包圍帝國沿線的城堡與稅站。拜占庭守軍以羅馬血統的弩砲與投石機死守城頭，圍城方則帶來攻城塔、撞車與填壕器材——羅馬式的攻城術在巴爾幹最後一次大規模實戰，落在的正是這條戰線。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是多瑙河下游的保加爾汗國與拜占庭帝國。保加爾一方並非單一民族國家，而是由可汗直轄的軍事聯盟：核心是汗族本部與布里雅特人等被征服的草原部眾，另有斯拉夫人、阿瓦爾人殘部與編入聯盟的邊民分擔兵役；可汗克魯姆在803年清除奧梅格之後掌權，把原本各自為政的部落重新編為可以持續作戰的國家機器，都城設在多瑙河南岸的普利斯卡，即古羅馬據點拉巴巴河谷一帶的舊壘上。軍隊以草原騎兵為骨幹，步兵與攻城器具隨軍轉移，營地按季節移動，能在數日之間跨越色雷斯平原。拜占庭一方則是完整的希臘—羅馬帝國：皇帝尼基福魯斯一世居君士坦丁堡，色雷斯軍區與馬其頓軍區的邊軍駐在色雷斯縱谷與愛琴海沿岸，首都禁衛軍與海軍（由海軍總管轄下分區艦隊）可以北調，牧首尼基福魯斯主持教會與外交。帝國在色雷斯的防禦並不是一支野戰軍隊，而是一整套羅馬時代留下的堡壘體系：塞薩洛尼基有五世紀的狄奧多西城牆與海牆，塞爾迪卡、菲利波波利斯、迪杜莫卡等城各有城牆與守備，黑海至馬爾馬拉海之間橫亙色雷斯的阿納斯塔西烏斯長牆把首都的門戶鎖死。第三方的存在同樣左右局勢：阿拔斯王朝的哈里發哈倫·拉希德在804至806年間以艦隊圍攻塞薩洛尼基，帝國海軍在805年的阿克修斯河口與卡爾基迪克海戰中擊潰阿拉伯艦隊，806年議和、807年交換俘虜；保加爾人正是趁帝國被阿拉伯戰線拖住時進入色雷斯，兩個戰場互相牽制。戰區周邊還有分散的斯拉夫部眾與不受任何一方控制的邊地，情報與糧秣的流向並不完全受控。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Bulgar Khaganate of the lower Danube and the Byzantine Empire. The Bulgar side was not a single ethnic state but a military confederation directly under the khan: its core was the khans' own people together with conquered steppe groups such as the Bryxi, with Slavs, Avar remnants and border communities drawn into the union sharing the military burden. Krum, who had removed Omeg in 803, ruled this structure and reorganised what had been a loose assembly of tribes into a state machine capable of sustained war; his capital stood at Pliska in the Lababa valley on the south bank of the Danube, on the site of an old Roman fort. His army had steppe cavalry as its backbone, with infantry and siege equipment moving with the columns and camps that shifted with the seasons, so that the host could cross the Thracian plain in a matter of days. The Byzantine side was the full Greek-Roman empire: Emperor Nikephoros I sat in Constantinople, the akritai of the Thracian and Macedonian themes garrisoned the Thracian valley and the Aegean coast, the tagmata of the capital and the navy (divided into districts under the droungarios tou ploimou) could be sent north, and Patriarch Nikephoros handled the church and the diplomacy. The empire's defence in Thrace was not a field army but a whole inherited fortress system: Thessalonica had the fifth-century Theodosian land wall and sea wall; Serdica, Philippopolis, Didymoteichon and the other towns had their own walls and garrisons; and the Anastasian Wall, running across Thrace between the Black Sea and the Sea of Marmara, locked the approaches to the capital. Third parties shaped the situation as much: the caliph Harun al-Rashid of the Abbasids blockaded Thessalonica with his fleet from 804 to 806, the imperial navy destroyed the Arab fleet in the naval actions at the mouth of the Axios and off Chalcidice in 805, a treaty was signed in 806 and prisoners were exchanged in 807; the Bulgars entered Thrace precisely while the empire was pinned down by the Arab front, and the two theatres pulled against each other. Around them the Thracian countryside also held scattered Slavic communities and border districts beyond the reach of either side, so that the movement of information and provisions was never entirely controlled by anyone.
people: 留下姓名的並不多，而且分佈在敵對的兩端。可汗克魯姆是這場戰爭的推動者：803年他除掉姻親奧梅格、奪得可汗位，隨後把聯盟內部的權力集中到自己手上，807年是他統治的第五年，這一年他率軍越過拜占庭邊界深入色雷斯；編年史描述他本人在軍中主持一切，既決定進攻方向，也親自挑選要攻的城鎮與渡口。另一端是皇帝尼基福魯斯一世（在位803至811年），807年時他面對的是北方草原與南方阿拉伯兩個方向同時受敵的局面，只能靠色雷斯與馬其頓的邊軍、海軍以及從首都趕來的援軍分擔。帝國一側真正留下文字的是同名的牧首尼基福魯斯（牧首任期806至815年），他的《簡史》（Ekthesis）敘述到806、807年前後為止，幾乎是本役最接近的同期記錄；狄奧菲洛西的《編年史》自800年起逐年記載，811年之後的戰局主要由他補上；另有《811年編年史》這部匿名者的作品，專門記述保加爾人與拜占庭帝國的衝突，作者站在拜占庭一邊，卻留下不少保加爾方面的細節，807年的戰況正落在這兩部編年史交接的地帶。拜占庭方面的戰場指揮者姓名多已失傳，色雷斯軍區的戰略兵統帥與海軍總管轄下的艦隊指揮者都只留下職銜；805年在阿克修斯河口擊敗阿拉伯艦隊的那位海軍統帥，通常認為是曾任海軍總管的尼基塔斯·科里安諾斯，807年他是否仍在位，史料並無交代。保加爾一方則在克魯姆身後出現了能談判的人：其子奧穆拉格在814年父死之後接位，815至816年間與拜占庭訂下十年之約，本役的後果最後是由他而不是克魯姆收場。
peopleEn: Few names survive, and they sit at opposite ends of the conflict. Khan Krum was the man who drove the war: in 803 he removed his kinsman Omeg and seized the khanship, and from then on concentrated the confederation's internal power in his own hands; 807 was the fifth year of his rule, and in that year he led the host across the Byzantine frontier and deep into Thrace. The chronicles show him presiding over everything in the field, deciding the direction of the advance and personally choosing which towns and river crossings to attack. At the other end stood Emperor Nikephoros I (r. 803-811), who in 807 was pressed from two directions at once, the steppe in the north and the Arabs in the south, and could only divide the burden between the akritai of Thrace and Macedonia, the navy, and reinforcements summoned from the capital. The man on the Byzantine side who actually left a text is the Patriarch Nikephoros of the same name (patriarch 806-815); his Short History (Ekthesis) carries the narrative to about 806-807 and is the closest contemporary record of the campaign. Theophanes the Confessor's Chronicle takes up the story year by year from 800 and supplies what happened after 811. There is also an anonymous Chronicle of 811 devoted specifically to the conflict between the Bulgars and the Byzantine Empire; its author writes from the Byzantine side yet preserves a good deal of detail about the Bulgar side, and the fighting of 807 falls exactly where these two chronicles hand over to one another. Most of the Byzantine commanders in the field have lost their names: the strategos of the Thracian theme and the commander of the squadrons under the droungarios tou ploimou survive only as offices. The naval commander who destroyed the Arab fleet at the mouth of the Axios in 805 is usually identified as Niketas Choriannos, once droungarios of the fleet; whether he was still in post in 807 is nowhere recorded. On the Bulgar side the man who could negotiate appears only after Krum is gone: his son Omurag succeeded him in 814 and concluded a ten-year truce with Byzantium in 815-816, so the consequences of this war were finally settled by him and not by Krum.
kits: 卡面上這具羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）是公元前50年前後羅馬軍中的標準火器：扭力弩砲，以木與青銅的扭簧儲力，一發一矢，弩矢長度以公尺計，威力足以在城牆上撕開缺口。放到807年的色雷斯，它已經不是當代的主戰裝備，而是一件「羅馬式」的代表物——本役的攻城技術已經走到投石機、雲梯與撞車的時代。真正上陣的是它的後裔：拜占庭野戰與守城部隊配備手擲式小型弩砲（cheiroballistra，士兵肩扛、以槓桿與腰力發射，是羅馬手提弩砲的直接後裔）與張弦式弩砲（epiballista，架在木製框架上、以絞盤張弦，一發一矢），破壞城牆與遠程壓制交給曳引式投石機（lithobolon）與配重投石機（mangana），城頭另備火矢（cheirosiphon）與投石；這套配備在九世紀末至十世紀的希臘文《戰術》手冊（常歸於君士坦丁七世的《戰略》與利奧六世的《戰術》）中已被逐項描述，可見其形制在807年已相當定型。圍攻方同樣用羅馬—拜占庭工匠傳下的技術：可移動的攻城塔（以生牛皮覆頂防火）、木製廊道、填壕用的柴束與土石，以及撞車；拜占庭編年史在談到其後的普利斯卡與塞爾迪卡攻守時，提到攻城者曾以大批攻城器與雲梯同時壓上城頭。畜力與運輸方面，保加爾人用草原小型馬匹，騎兵兩三人一組結隊掠行，並以牛車馱運帳幕、箭壺與攻城構件；拜占庭靠海運把糧食、箭矢與石灰送上塞薩洛尼基的城頭，用快速帆船（dromon）與小型划艇在塞薩洛尼基灣穿梭，禁衛軍的援軍則以馬匹接力自君士坦丁堡北調。羅馬弩砲的真正位置因此很清楚：它已退到軍械庫與技術譜系的層面，作為「拜占庭城防仍屬羅馬技術後裔」的註腳，而不是戰場上真正開火的那件武器。
kitsEn: The Roman ballista on the card (Scorpio) was standard artillery in the Roman army around 50 BC: a torsion engine wound with skeins of wood and bronze, one bolt to a shot, with bolts measured in metres and enough power to tear a breach in a city wall. Set in Thrace in 807 it was no longer the weapon of the field but a representative of the Roman manner, for the siegecraft of this campaign had already moved on to stone-throwers, siege towers and rams. What actually fought were its descendants. The Byzantine field and garrison troops carried the hand-thrown small bolt-thrower (cheiroballistra, shouldered and released with lever and body weight, a direct descendant of the Roman hand ballista) and the spanning bolt-thrower (epiballista, mounted on a wooden frame and drawn with a windlass, one bolt to a shot); the work of breaching walls and of standoff bombardment fell to the traction stone-thrower (lithobolon) and the counterweight trebuchet (mangana), with fire-pots (cheirosiphon) and missiles for the wall-walks. That inventory is described item by item in the Greek tactical manuals of the late ninth and tenth centuries, commonly attributed to Constantine VII's Taktikon and Leo VI's Tactica, which shows the forms to have been well settled by 807. The besiegers worked with the same technology handed down by Roman and Byzantine craftsmen: mobile siege towers roofed with rawhide to keep out fire, timber galleries, brushwood and rubble for filling the ditches, and battering rams; the Byzantine chronicles, when they come to the later sieges of Pliska and Serdica, record the attackers bringing up masses of siege engines and towers against the walls at the same time. For motive power and transport the Bulgars used small steppe horses, riding two or three abreast in bands, and hauled tents, arrow cases and siege timbers on ox-carts; Byzantium carried grain, arrows and lime up to the walls of Thessalonica by sea, using fast sailing ships (dromons) and small rowing craft in the Thermaic Gulf, while the relieving tagmata came north from Constantinople relayed on horses. The true position of the Roman ballista is therefore clear: it had fallen back to the arsenal and to the level of technological pedigree, serving as a footnote that Byzantine fortification remained a descendant of Roman technique rather than as the weapon that actually fired on the field.
tactics: 保加爾人的打法與拜占庭的守城經驗相撞，但兩邊的技術形態不同。進攻方在開闊的色雷斯平原上以騎兵大縱隊先行，掃清拜占庭的前哨稅站與小堡，迫使帝國的邊軍退守城池；隨後才讓慢速的攻城車隊跟上，選擇城牆較舊、駐軍較少的一處展開圍城，避免與帝國主力野戰，也不強攻設防最厚的普利斯卡與塞薩洛尼基。圍城技術是混合式的：壕溝以柴束與土石填平，接近面築起覆以生牛皮的攻城塔與木廊，弓手與擲石兵覆蓋城頭，撞車對準城門；同時分兵切斷城外的道路與田莊，斷糧逼迫守軍出城作戰。拜占庭方面以「守城加海上控制」對付：城頭配置弩砲與投石機壓制進攻者，燃燒的油與火矢對付攻城塔；色雷斯與馬其頓的邊軍以小隊游擊襲擊攻城者的營地與採糧隊，拖延其補給；海軍總管轄下的艦隊控制塞薩洛尼基灣與阿克修斯河口，任何援軍若從海上來，就必須先確認海峽的安全。實際的會面多發生在城下的丘陵與水道之間，而不是開闊地上的會戰。雙方當時都剛剛經歷過另一場大規模圍城：804至806年阿拉伯艦隊圍塞薩洛尼基、805年帝國海軍在河口打的那一場海戰，使807年的每一個將領都清楚海上交通的重要性——拜占庭把海軍集中到塞薩洛尼基灣不是為了登陸反攻，而是為了切斷圍城者的糧道與援兵；帝國的應變速度則取決於驛騎接力，自君士坦丁堡到色雷斯前線要走五百至六百公里，消息與援軍要走上十日至半個月。戰爭因此呈現拉鋸的形態：保加爾人來去如潮，靠速度與破壞取利；帝國靠城牆、海軍與補給硬撐，等援軍與時節轉變，再逐個逼退圍城者。
tacticsEn: The Bulgar method collided with Byzantine experience of defence, but the two sides' technological forms were different. The attackers led with large columns of cavalry across the open Thracian plain, clearing the Byzantine forward tax-posts and small forts and forcing the imperial akritai back into their cities; only then did the slow siege train follow, choosing a place where the walls were older and the garrison smaller, and avoiding a set-piece battle with the imperial field army rather than assaulting Pliska or Thessalonica where the defences were thickest. The siege technique was hybrid: ditches filled with brushwood and rubble, approaches raised with hide-covered towers and timber galleries, archers and slingers covering the wall-heads, rams brought up against the gates; at the same time detachments were sent out to cut the roads and estates outside the walls, starving the defenders into sorties. Byzantium answered by holding the city and controlling the sea: bolt-throwers and stone-throwers on the walls to bear down on the attackers, burning oil and fire-pots against the towers; the akritai of Thrace and Macedonia harassing the besiegers' camp and foraging parties with small raiding bands to delay their supply; and the squadrons under the droungarios tou ploimou holding the Thermaic Gulf and the mouth of the Axios, so that any relief arriving by sea had first to establish that the straits were safe. The actual contact took place among the hills and waterways below the walls rather than in any set-piece battle in the open. Both sides had just been through another great siege: the blockade of Thessalonica by the Arab fleet from 804 to 806, and the naval action in the river mouth in 805, taught every commander of 807 what the sea meant for movement. Byzantium concentrated its fleet in the Thermaic Gulf not to land an offensive but to cut the besiegers' supply line and their relief; and the empire's speed of reaction was bounded by the horse relay, five hundred to six hundred kilometres from Constantinople to the Thracian front, so that news and reinforcements took ten days to a fortnight. The war therefore took the form of an attritional seesaw: the Bulgars moved in and out like the tide, taking profit from speed and destruction; the empire held on with walls, ships and supply, and as reinforcements and the season turned, pushed the besiegers away one at a time.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但有幾個硬指標。第一是時序：807年是克魯姆掌權的第五年（803年即位），同年帝國與阿拔斯王朝執行806年所訂的條約，阿拔斯方面派員到博斯普魯斯海峽交換俘虜，兩個戰場幾乎同步。第二是地理量度：可汗都城普利斯卡在多瑙河南岸的拉巴巴河谷，南下至塞薩洛尼基的直線距離約三百五十公里，沿色雷斯軍用大道（經菲利波波利斯、迪迪莫提科往君士坦丁堡）到首都的路程約五百至六百公里；快馬接力把這段路壓縮到十日至半個月，就是帝國應變速度的物理上限。第三是防禦硬體：橫亙色雷斯的阿納斯塔西烏斯長牆（黑海至馬爾馬拉海）全長約五十六公里，關樓之間按羅馬軍制配備弓弩手，這條牆是草原騎兵南下的第一道閘門；塞薩洛尼基的狄奧多西城牆與海牆建於五世紀，是羅馬晚期城防的樣式，其城頭正是弩砲與投石機的射界所在。第四是航運與戰役長度：804至806年阿拉伯圍城延續約兩年，帝國海軍在805年的阿克修斯河口與卡爾基迪克海戰中以損失數艘戰船的代價全毀阿拉伯艦隊，俘虜交換延續到807年。第五是本役之後的刻度：809年保加爾人圍攻塞爾迪卡，811年普利斯卡之戰中拜占庭皇帝尼基福魯斯一世陣亡、帝國在色雷斯的堡壘體系崩解，813年塞爾迪卡陷落，814年克魯姆去世，815至816年間其子奧穆拉格與帝國訂下十年之約。至於雙方投入的確切兵力、攻城器數目、陣亡與俘虜總數，編年史只用「無數」「大批」一類修辭，沒有可核的實數，不宜當作數據使用；出兵的確切月份，現存編年史也沒有留下，只能按草原騎兵開春放牧後才動身的季節推斷落在夏初。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few, but several are hard. First, chronology: 807 was the fifth year of Krum's rule (he had taken the khanship in 803), and in the same year the empire was carrying out the treaty signed in 806, with an Abbasid delegation coming to the Bosporus to exchange prisoners, so the two theatres were almost synchronised. Second, geography: the khan's capital Pliska lay in the Lababa valley on the south bank of the Danube, roughly three hundred and fifty kilometres in a straight line from Thessalonica, and five hundred to six hundred kilometres by the military road through Philippopolis and Didymoteichon to the capital; the horse relay compressed that run into ten days to a fortnight, and that was the physical limit on the empire's speed of reaction. Third, the hard defences: the Anastasian Wall running across Thrace from the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara is about fifty-six kilometres long, its gate-towers garrisoned by archer and javelin troops according to the Roman system, and it was the first barrier the steppe cavalry had to break on the way south; the Theodosian land wall and sea wall of Thessalonica, built in the fifth century, are the model of late Roman fortification, and their wall-heads are exactly where the bolt-throwers and stone-throwers had their fields of fire. Fourth, shipping and the length of the fighting: the Arab blockade ran for roughly two years from 804 to 806, the imperial navy destroyed the Arab fleet at the Axios and off Chalcidice in 805 at the cost of a handful of its own ships, and the exchange of prisoners ran on into 807. Fifth, the markers that follow: the siege of Serdica in 809, the Battle of Pliska in 811 in which Emperor Nikephoros I fell and the imperial fortress system in Thrace came apart, the fall of Serdica in 813, the death of Krum in 814, and the ten-year truce concluded between his son Omurag and the empire in 815-816. As for the exact numbers engaged, the number of siege engines, and the totals of dead and prisoners, the chronicles offer only rhetoric such as countless and great numbers, with no checkable actuals, and those should not be used as data. The precise month in which the host set out is likewise not recorded, and can only be inferred from the season, steppe cavalry moving out after the spring grazing, to fall in early summer.
cause: 開戰的動因，是多瑙河下游的草原聯盟與拜占庭帝國在色雷斯的結構性矛盾。聯盟原本靠游牧與劫掠維持，克魯姆把它整編成國家機器之後，就必須有穩定的財源與牧場；色雷斯是東南歐最富庶的農業區之一，也是通往愛琴海與君士坦丁堡的走廊，控制它等於控制稅收與牧場的季節性轉移，也等於握有向地中海販賣穀物、牲畜與戰俘的通路。拜占庭一邊並不甘心讓出這條走廊：帝國在色雷斯的軍區與堡壘體系本身就是一道關卡，把草原勢力擋在山隘與多瑙河之間；帝國還試圖以收編、徵稅與傳教的方式消化邊境上的部眾，這與聯盟要維護的部族自主直接衝突。時機同樣關鍵：804至806年阿拔斯艦隊圍攻塞薩洛尼基，帝國在色雷斯的駐軍與海軍都被抽調或牽制，北方防線出現空隙；克魯姆選擇在此時開戰，等於用對手的戰時消耗換取自己的進攻窗口。對克魯姆本人而言，這場戰爭還有更深一層的意義：他需要向聯盟內部的追隨者證明可汗的位置帶來財富與榮耀，沒有掠奪就沒有服從，因此他必須打到色雷斯的平原上，而不能停在多瑙河畔。帝國一邊則沒有太多選擇：色雷斯失守會直接暴露馬其頓軍區與通往首都的路，因此即便必須在兩條戰線上分兵，也不能放棄色雷斯。
causeEn: What set the war going was the structural contradiction between the steppe confederation of the lower Danube and the Byzantine Empire over Thrace. The confederation had subsisted on pastoralism and plunder; once Krum had turned it into a state machine it needed stable revenue and pasture, and Thrace was one of the richest agricultural regions of south-eastern Europe as well as the corridor to the Aegean and to Constantinople. Holding it meant holding the seasonal transfer of taxes and pasture, and the route by which grain, livestock and captives were sold into the Mediterranean. Byzantium was equally unwilling to give that corridor up: the themes and the fortress system in Thrace were themselves a barrier that kept the steppe powers behind the mountain passes and the Danube, and the empire tried to absorb the border populations by enrolment, taxation and preaching, which collided directly with the tribal autonomy the confederation existed to protect. The timing mattered as much: with the Abbasid fleet blockading Thessalonica from 804 to 806, the imperial garrisons and navy in Thrace were drawn off or pinned down, and the northern line opened a gap; by opening the war then, Krum was trading the enemy's wartime strain for his own window of opportunity. For Krum personally the war carried a deeper meaning: he had to show the followers inside the confederation that the position of khan brought wealth and glory, and without plunder there was no obedience, which is why he had to fight out onto the Thracian plain rather than stop at the Danube. The empire had little room to choose: the loss of Thrace would expose the Macedonian theme and the road to the capital, so even with forces split between two fronts it could not let Thrace go.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響，是把拜占庭與草原勢力的對抗從邊境衝突推成一段長達十年的消耗戰，並改寫了帝國在巴爾幹的處境。第一，色雷斯的堡壘體系在807年之後被證明不足以單獨擋住保加爾人，帝國的應對從單純守城轉為海上控制、外交周旋與逐點加固三重手段；806年訂立、自807年起執行的十年阿拉伯休戰，使帝國得以把注意力與艦隊集中到北方，這與807年正好是同一條戰略主線的兩端。第二，戰爭促使帝國重新檢視安納托利亞海峽對岸與色雷斯的邊防體系，長期被視為邊陲的堡壘與長牆被重新編入軍區編制，成為之後數個世紀拜占庭對付草原入侵的骨架。第三，從保加爾一側看，807年之後的攻勢把聯盟推成東南歐的強權：809年的塞爾迪卡、811年的普利斯卡、813年的塞爾迪卡陷落，說明草原聯盟已能把攻城能力當作常態手段；而這正是羅馬時代攻城技術譜系在巴爾幹最後一次大規模的實戰運用——羅馬弩砲這類單發扭力火器雖已退場，羅馬式的攻城術卻隨著工匠與被俘的技術人員進入草原營地。第四，戰爭結果改變了教會與外交的布局：拜占庭教會在巴爾幹南部的傳播被保加爾人的受洗與教會建制反過來推動，帝國與草原政權之間出現了以信仰、贖金與年度貢賦為內容的長期關係，這種關係在815年之後的十年休戰中被制度化，並一直延續到十四世紀君士坦丁堡陷落之後。
impactEn: The effect of this war was to push the confrontation between Byzantium and the steppe powers from a border clash into a decade of attritional conflict, and to reshape the empire's position in the Balkans. First, the fortress system of Thrace was shown after 807 to be insufficient on its own to hold the Bulgars, and the imperial response broadened from simple defence to three things at once: control of the sea, diplomatic manoeuvring, and piecemeal reinforcement. The ten-year Arab truce signed in 806 and in force from 807 allowed the empire to concentrate its attention and its fleet on the north, and that truce and the campaign of 807 are the two ends of the same strategic line. Second, the war forced a fresh look at the frontier system of Thrace and the opposite shore of the Anatolian straits; fortresses and long walls long treated as marginal were folded back into the thematic order, and became the skeleton on which Byzantium later met steppe invasions for centuries. Third, from the Bulgar side, the offensives after 807 turned the confederation into a power in south-eastern Europe: Serdica in 809, Pliska in 811 and the fall of Serdica in 813 show the steppe confederation able to treat siegecraft as a routine capability, and that was the last large-scale field use in the Balkans of the Roman siegecraft tradition. The single-shot torsion engines such as the Roman ballista had already been retired, but the Roman manner of siegecraft travelled into the steppe camp with craftsmen and with technical men taken prisoner. Fourth, the result rearranged church and diplomatic arrangements: Byzantine preaching in the southern Balkans was pushed forward by the conversion of the Bulgars and by the building of a Bulgarian church structure, and a long relationship between the empire and the steppe polity emerged, one conducted in matters of faith, ransom and annual tribute. That relationship was institutionalised in the ten-year truce after 815 and lasted on past the fall of Constantinople in the fourteenth century.
result: 807年這一仗，雙方都沒有拿到決定性的東西。可汗的軍隊深入色雷斯，包圍並破壞了帝國的多處邊防據點，卻沒有佔領塞薩洛尼基，也沒有攻下任何一座真正重要的城池；帝國的守軍靠城牆、海軍與游擊遲滯了進攻，援軍與季節最後拖垮了保加爾人的攻城部隊，戰事以僵持收場。對拜占庭而言，代價是邊境收入中斷、前沿堡壘損壞，以及帝國在北方戰線上長期僵持的消耗；對可汗而言，代價是攻勢的節奏被城牆與海軍拖慢，必須改為反覆出擊才能取得成果。戰爭並沒有在807年結束，反而一路延長：809年圍塞爾迪卡、811年普利斯卡之戰中皇帝尼基福魯斯一世陣亡、813年塞爾迪卡陷落，直到814年克魯姆去世，815至816年其子奧穆拉格才與帝國訂下十年之約，把色雷斯的邊界暫時固定下來。裝備層面則留下一個清楚註腳：本役中真正決定守城成敗的，已經不是卡面那具羅馬弩砲——單發的扭力火器在八世紀末早已讓位給手擲弩砲、張弦弩砲與投石機；羅馬式的攻城術仍然有效，只是它的繼承者分處兩邊：拜占庭把它用在城頭，保加爾人把它帶到城下。
resultEn: In the fighting of 807 neither side got a decisive outcome. The khan's host went deep into Thrace, surrounded and damaged a number of the empire's frontier posts, but took neither Thessalonica nor any genuinely important city; the Byzantine defence, with its walls, its navy and its raiding bands, slowed the advance, and reinforcements together with the turning season eventually wore out the Bulgar siege crews, so the campaign ended in stalemate. For Byzantium the costs were interrupted frontier revenue, damaged forward forts and a long grinding commitment on the northern front; for the khan the cost was a tempo slowed by walls and by the fleet, so that results had to be sought in repeated raids instead. The war did not end in 807 but ran on: the siege of Serdica in 809, the Battle of Pliska in 811 in which Emperor Nikephoros I was killed, the fall of Serdica in 813, and only after Krum's death in 814 did his son Omurag conclude a ten-year treaty with the empire in 815-816, fixing the Thracian frontier for a time. On the equipment side there is one clear footnote: what actually decided the defence was no longer the Roman ballista on the card. Single-shot torsion engines had given way to hand-thrown bolt-throwers, spanning bolt-throwers and stone-throwers by the end of the eighth century. The Roman manner of siegecraft remained effective all the same; only its inheritors had changed sides, Byzantium setting it on the walls and the Bulgars bringing it to the foot of them.
